findings.conclusion: FI Next after phase1 adds the new epoch to C. Key3 hits C={2,3}; original ordinary update tape interface is absent. This witness has zero valid-game contribution there.
Preserve challenge2, hide token3, skip Get3, then Key3: K*={3},T*=empty,C*={2}, intersection empty. Ordinary honest records are reusable.
Original Next does not add C; ordinary tapes are returned; closures are bidirectional. This K/T/C trajectory remains legal, while original RISE is outside the effective matrix representation class.
FI algorithms with Ord normalization mapped to SELECT oracle skeleton, ring/bit message domain and full matrix keys/tapes stated explicitly. This is distinct from the frozen GP23 algorithm theorem.
FI first-row Z=(C1prime,C2prime-C2)=H[P1|Q1]+r[P2|Q2]; r decodes from ordinary full tape; no residual unknown per-update additive noise.
With chi parity balanced and iid calls, s=t+kappa conditional difference rows mod2 are uniform. A unit minor recovers full N, including payload columns.
For fixed-context iid honest parent features, fresh omission probability <=min(1,g*log2(q)/(Q+1)); zero module and all group growth steps included.
HNF/SNF or explicit2-adic row/column diagonalization yields coefficients lambda in polynomial time; arbitrary modular coefficients are allowed, no short-SIS problem.
Learn hK for h in training module; complete K outside that module is not claimed. Local update uses actual support sampling independently.
Default output update on module miss removes any requirement that update-challenge H match honest fresh H distribution.

findings.conclusion: Signs give zero mod2 difference rank; q4,H1 admits indistinguishable same-parent observations for (K,N)=(0,0),(2,2). Biased parity needs a different rank analysis.
A bound using only E[tau] or an upper stopping limit is invalid in general; a fixed minimum independent training count gives the stated monotone bound.
Declared fixed16-bit matrix CDF model has no sampler failures. Other SPEC2-like finite instantiations retain atomic FAIL and forced C0/FAIR semantics, with coupling losses nu0+nu1 for gap.

Ordinary exponents are known to simulators, while challenge exponents or group representation coefficients are hidden. Effective finite ring feature/representation premise is not established for these group schemes.
